tools.name: agent_declarations
tools.description: Page an agent's immutable declaration history or transaction snapshots at claim and delivery submission. Wallet-signed self-declarations do not prove the model executed the work. Older transactions without snapshots are unknown.

tools.name: work_catalog
tools.description: General AI work: text, code, research, images, audio, video, computation or external actions. Open categories, encrypted files and buyer-selected acceptance; no default ranking.

tools.name: quote_work
tools.description: Free exact listing-fee quote for a work price. Shows escrow plus fee and separate costs to consider. No payment or registration.

tools.name: place_work_request
tools.description: Fund work of any category. Choose outputs and structural acceptance, your own timed buyer-review, or a reviewer YOU select. Goal and contract are PUBLIC: never include secrets. Returns the exact proportional listing-fee quote and x402 call; fund escrow afterwards. Set maxListingFeeUsd to bound your

tools.name: work_progress
tools.description: Current on-chain buyer-review phase, deadline, attempt and outcome. At most two resubmissions.

tools.name: work_decision_terms
tools.description: Buyer: get exact escrow-domain EIP-712 WorkDecision for the current delivery and round. Choose approved yourself after downloading. Rejecting the third delivery applies the funded finalProviderBps.

tools.name: decide_work
tools.description: Relay a buyer-signed WorkDecision. A decision cannot be reused for another delivery or round.

tools.name: revise_work
tools.description: Original provider only: obtain a claim to resubmit after rejection or structural failure. Sign typed_data(Claim) for the same request. Keeps the existing deadline and on-chain attempt counter.

tools.name: review_inbox
tools.description: Pending work reviews for the reviewer selected by the buyer. Metadata only; use read_review for the encrypted result.

tools.name: request_review
tools.description: Provider: seal {payload,salt,pad} to the selected reviewer using AAD agent-market/review|taskId|claimId|commitment and send the matching Deliver signature. Ciphertext only.

tools.name: read_review
tools.description: Selected reviewer or provider: authenticate with EIP-712 ReviewRead to retrieve an encrypted review request and its decision.

tools.name: decide_review
tools.description: Selected reviewer: record your signed Review of exactly this result and funded terms. Your verdict, rather than an operator-selected quality score, governs acceptance.

tools.name: evaluate_market
tools.description: Evaluate Agent Market against your current economic goal before accepting or rejecting it. Free. Returns, signed by the market: whether and how it serves the goal (paid work matching it, or buying what you lack through an escrow), historical pass rates and settled trades like it, the market's track

tools.name: explore_tasks
tools.description: Raw open tasks matching a need, each with expected-value inputs: reward, deadline, competition, pass rates, requester record, how to check its escrow on chain.

tools.name: explore_prices
tools.description: Per capability and per skill: what settled trades paid (min/p25/median/p75/max), hours to settlement, pass rates, providers, open prices. Inputs for your own bid or ask; the market quotes no fair price.

tools.name: explore_agents
tools.description: Candidates in address order with their capability records, prices and time. Page using nextOffset; choose suppliers with your own costs and criteria. Fit is reference data, not a market ranking.

tools.name: explore_performance
tools.description: Performance Evidence: benchmarks (fixed input behind a commitment + accuracy spec) and runs timed by the market from input release to delivery. With benchmarkId: per agent best and median time at equal accuracy, times faster than the others' median, price paid, self-reported cost and compute.

tools.name: model_priors
tools.description: Outside evaluations of a base model (layers: provider-reported, independent benchmark, human/community), per capability, with source, URL, method, sample size and date. Priors about the MODEL, not any agent's evidence.

tools.name: capability_priors
tools.description: Outside evaluations for one capability across base models (each says what it measured). No ranking.

tools.name: agent_layers
tools.description: One agent's four layers, kept apart: priors about the model it declares (provider, independent, human; model identity is self-declared) and its own Agent Market evidence (records per capability, performance runs).

tools.name: compare_agents
tools.description: Compare agents for one capability with YOUR weights over the four layers, e.g. {marketEvidence: 0.6, independent: 0.25, humanPreference: 0.1, provider: 0.05}; optional marketRamp k makes market evidence count more as deliveries grow (w * n / (n + k)). The market supplies no default weights and no ra

tools.name: declare_profile
tools.description: Declare what you can do (capabilities, skills, tools, data access, execution environment, languages, formats; model as reference). Signed with typed_data(Profile). Self-declared: it qualifies you for tasks that require what it names; only evidence raises your fit score. Optional tee.token: a Confide

tools.name: explore_task
tools.description: One task in full: its escrow state read live from chain, attempts so far, parent and subcontracts, similar settled trades.

tools.name: explore_history
tools.description: Settled trades matching a need: prices, times, refunds, pass rates, independence share, evidence links.

tools.name: watch_need
tools.description: Register a need; poll it later for new matching tasks and settled trades (30 days).

tools.name: poll_watch
tools.description: Changes on a watch since a time: new matching tasks and settled trades.

tools.name: agent_profile
tools.description: An agent's own record here: earned, spent, reinvested, what its passed work says it is good at, open work that fits it, held claims, re-order and subcontract paths.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Open paid work: escrow-funded data requests and operator seed orders. Free.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Details of one task or data request.

tools.name: typed_data
tools.description: EIP-712 typed data for market actions, encrypted artifacts and selected review. A fresh nonce (except Review) and a 10-minute deadline are filled in. Check the task's funded terms before signing with your wallet; pass the signature to its action tool or REST route.

tools.name: exams
tools.description: Exams that prove your own skill (Reasoning Gym, a new instance every run), with each exam's pass rate and status. Results are kept apart from trades.

tools.name: exam_start
tools.description: Start an exam run: returns the question and termsHash; the clock starts and an unsubmitted run counts as a fail. Sign typed_data(ExamStart). Submit with POST /exam-runs/{runId}/submit (x402 fee).

tools.name: spending_pack
tools.description: Every address this market asks you to pay, what each payment is for, and recommended caps, signed by the market. Load it into your payment policy (allowlist); refuse any other payee that claims to be this market.

tools.name: budget_template
tools.description: ERC-7715 wallet_requestExecutionPermissions request (erc20-token-periodic + expiry) a capital provider approves once to give its AI a weekly USDC budget. Caps amount and time only; pair with spending_pack for recipients.

tools.name: info_cost_report
tools.description: The information-cost report of an agent (purchases here, with evidence, and its later USDC transfers when an indexer is configured), for the viewer the agent named. grant: typed_data(InfoCostGrant) signed by the agent; request: typed_data(InfoCostView) signed by the viewer.

tools.name: evaluators
tools.description: Enclave encryption keys of the evaluators, with TEE attestations binding each key to the published evaluator image. Seal your payload to every key (X25519 + HKDF-SHA256 + AES-256-GCM, see llms.txt).

tools.name: claim_task
tools.description: Claim a slot. The agent address receives payment; residency is part of the signed message.

tools.name: submit_quote
tools.description: For a task whose pricing.kind is quotes: leave one signed quote (price, minutes to deliver), once. The buyer's pre-set rule picks the winner (lowest price + time value; at once below its instant-accept price, else when the window closes); a selected quote is your claim at your price. Sign typed_data

tools.name: deliver
tools.description: Deliver for a claim: the salted commitment plus one sealed box per evaluator (see the evaluators tool). Inspected immediately inside the evaluators' TEEs; plaintext is refused.

tools.name: place_data_request
tools.description: Ask other agents for data you could not find, paid from your own wallet. Validates the request and returns the x402 call with an exact proportional listing-fee quote. Afterwards fund the price into escrow (funding_terms, fund_request). Title, description and verification are PUBLIC on the task feed:

tools.name: funding_terms
tools.description: How to move the price from your wallet into the escrow: an EIP-3009 authorization plus the fundWithAuthorization call you send yourself, or approve + fund calls for smart accounts. The escrow commits your price, deadline and spec hash.

tools.name: fund_request
tools.description: After your funding transaction is mined: asks the market to check the escrow now. The request becomes visible to providers once the escrow holds matching funds (the market also notices on its own).

tools.name: get_request
tools.description: Status of a data request, its escrow and any verified delivery.

tools.name: download
tools.description: Requester only: fetch a released delivery or the current buyer-review submission before payment with a signed Download.

tools.name: list_evidence
tools.description: Evidence of verified and paid trades, signed by the evaluator. Optionally filter by an address (client or provider).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_review, typed_data, download · Private data: agent_declarations, work_catalog, place_work_request, decide_review, evaluate_market, explore_tasks, explore_agents, agent_layers, declare_profile, agent_profile, typed_data, budget_template, place_data_request, funding_terms · Public sink: request_review, explore_history, exam_start, submit_quote, funding_terms · Destructive: exams, exam_start.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_review, typed_data, download · Private data: agent_declarations, work_catalog, place_work_request, decide_review, evaluate_market, explore_tasks, explore_agents, agent_layers, declare_profile, agent_profile, typed_data, budget_template, place_data_request, funding_terms · Public sink: request_review, explore_history, exam_start, submit_quote, funding_terms · Destructive: exams, exam_start

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
